# LibraryTree PR01 frozen vectors for Rust and future MASM host tests.
# id | full Eidos domain tag (0 for native Merkle) | canonical bytes hex or - | payload u64s | digest u64s
# Blank payload means zero Felts. Numbers are decimal or 0x-prefixed hexadecimal.
# Label bytes are the complete canonical label envelope; object bytes are exact D1 records.
# Namespace/domain-only rows have no byte codec. Word coordinates are always forward order.
# Spec Page: https://chatgpt.com/space/page_11597d3254d8819196b4f5b3d0d13718
# Retrieved: 2026-11-02. Canonical Markdown snapshot SHA-256:
# 2dc0e18959b4cb37068ce6ae6d139a8e2c461b0e51e41a7724352fb2f89e65c5
# Independent portable seven-round BLAKE3/Eidos reference SHA-256:
# 3e21a5f3217f2b702f539e709343c990fe4fa62c66df7509e3c0d4abb4544834
# Reference calibrated against existing generic empty/three/nine-Felt vectors.
# Transcribed from frozen Rust literals and independent label/object reference records;
# no production hasher or encoder generated these expectations. Synthetic TypedId is not AccountId.
# D1 codec decision: user-approved plan, commit b10d3ff5e, 2026-11-02.
# Native Merkle cutover: object_merkle uses the reserved zero frame, not FeltSequence length 8.
# Its new digest was computed by the same independent reference, calibrated against generic
# empty/three/nine-Felt vectors and the retained legacy_object_merkle vector. D1 bytes are unchanged.
